purpose: Teach: 白色/股/壺/杭/便器/ふじ/カンガルー/凡人

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが白色のシャツに合うネクタイを選んで下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father picked out a tie to go with his white shirt.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact. Light voice. The tone of a mother sharing something her child will find meaningful. Slight uplift at the end — not quite a question, but inviting him to notice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに股関節のストレッチを教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me how to do hip stretches.
lines.style: Eager, clear voice. Pride underneath the simplicity — he's sharing something he learned, something that means he spent time with Dad. Direct gaze. A child's quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが古い壺、つまり花瓶の手入れをして下さってるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's been taking care of that old vase — the one in the living room.
lines.style: Soft, observational. A pause before 'that old vase' — she's remembering, noticing. Warm without being sentimental. The rhythm of someone noticing small, steady things.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと庭の杭を直したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I fixed the fence post in the yard together.
lines.style: Steady, satisfied. The voice of a small boy who did something real with his father. Not boasting — just stating a fact that makes sense to him. A little quieter than before, more grounded.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが便器のお掃除も手伝って下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father even helped clean the bathroom.
lines.style: Tender and slightly amused. The voice of a mother noticing all the ways her husband shows up — even the unglamorous ones. Warm acceptance, no edge of complaint.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと富士、つまりふじの絶景を観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I saw Mount Fuji — the view was beautiful.
lines.style: Wonder in the voice. A child who saw something that mattered. Small but present breath before 'beautiful' — he's holding onto the moment. Eyes might be a little wider.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「動物園のカンガルーを観に行こう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was saying he wanted to take you to see the kangaroos at the zoo.
lines.style: Light, conversational. She's sharing a plan, a future thing. Warm, not forceful. The tone of a mother passing along a promise her husband made, trusting the boy will hear his father in it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「ぼくは凡人だから努力するんだ」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me that even ordinary people have to work hard to get better.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. A child repeating something that landed for him — something his father said that he understood. Slower pace. The seriousness of a six-year-old learning something true.
